1_blockout.notes: SCULPT REFERENCE ONLY - never shipped, never copied to assets/models/, never rigged. The birefnet mask keeps the whole figure (nothing lost beyond 9 px), but a first run on the plain concept (s101, local in work/first_input/) made the two floating coils ~1 m barrels in depth and fused the ground around the head with the crown shards into a second hair mass, so the input is the front with a verified alpha (coils cut, head ground keyed out). TRELLIS.2 (Pixal3D pruned), 3 seeds (101/202/303) at the user character settings (700k faces, 4096 px), 291-308 s each. s303 picked: the only slim female face with pale skin and eyes and silver-white hair, the concept deep storm-blue cloth (s101/s202 went teal-cyan, the P2-ring colour), five clean clawed fingers, two legs with the tabard and panels free at the knee, span/height 0.961 (concept 0.932), no hole over 1.6 cm. Known defects (reports/blockout_report.md section 6): the bun is a separate mass ~0.2 m behind the head with a hair tail (all seeds), the six crown shards are fused into the hair as side prongs, thick partly fused cloth, no emissive, baked lighting. The seed pick is an engineering judgement; the user visual approval comes at stage 2.

2_production_mesh.notes: Production mesh made by the AI pipeline (the Brax / Valdris method), not a stand-in. The CC0 MakeHuman hm08 body (MPFB used as a tool only) as a tall slender woman, landmark-warped to the blockout's heights and the concept's arm segments in a clean upright T-pose (2.2 m to the bun top, span 2.00 m, heeled feet), leg girth set for the leggings, empty hands (the thundercoil_launcher is a separate weapon on weapon_R; the concept's two floating coils are not built). Around it, closed parts: the swept-up hair shell with the high twisted bun, a glowing band, face-framing strands and swept clumps; SIX gold-rimmed storm-crystal shards floating round the head, one rigid piece each for x_crown_01..06 (the concept draws six; the stage brief said five: pending the user); the high collar with the faceted collar gem, harness straps, the neckline trim and the waist straps; the belt with two gold rings and hip plates; shoulder armlets with rings and blades; two deep storm-blue outer capes, two pale shoulder drapes, two hip panels, the front tabard and a back panel as regular cloth grids ready for x_ helper chains; bracers, back-of-hand plates and ten ice-blue claw caps; greaves, pointed knee cops, knee fins; heeled pointed sabatons. 22,356 triangles, 84 rigid pieces, 8 cloth sheets, 0 boundary / 0 non-manifold edges. One 2048 atlas: hand-painted NPR base colour from palette.json (no baked lighting), a 2048 emissive (eyes, gem, arm and cheek lightning veins, greave / sabaton V slots, crystals, claws, bun band: 0.5 % of the atlas, the P2-cyan rule), a 2048 tangent normal map baked from the recentred blockout. glTF check ok. Review sheets in reports/stage2/ (Cycles CPU / Workbench); known limits and the stage-3 bone plan in reports/stage2_production_mesh.md. The remaining human gate is the user's visual approval (item user_visual_approval).
